digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today produced clearer next steps for the active portfolio work, while the dashboard still shows nine consolidated follow-ups open. Tuesday’s calendar is concentrated around two meeting sequences, so carrying one decision-and-owner narrative across them will keep the day moving.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery and Denver go-live gate
items.detail: Voicemail is restored and direct-to-agent and transfer routing were validated, but the Lambda workaround, testing restart criteria, skills and user setup, and Denver go/no-go evidence remain open. Jean told the ELT group that Amazon Connect was the main blocker and that the team was working it.

items.label: Lock the Sprint 21 scope against the 95-point capacity
items.detail: Confirm the final story list, compliance tradeoffs, and explicit owners for anything blocked or unestimated, keeping the roughly 40% capacity demand from Send Letters Queue 2.0 visible.

items.label: Turn the Contigo discussion into a go/no-go decision plan
items.detail: Evan agreed that Legal and Operations engagement is weak. Start with a clear conversation and written list of needs for Cristian, use Andrew only if necessary, and close the remaining cost, capacity, handoff, and ownership gaps ahead of the November 6 decision.

items.label: Close the MHE expansion’s remaining ownership gaps
items.detail: The direction is to screen Florida and Texas clients at the declaration stage and refer eligible cases to Roots; Illinois referrals may be ready in roughly two weeks. Confirm the provider-and-state document, the IT owner and dates, and whether existing inboxes and task flows can support the next rollout.

items.label: Resolve the outstanding project and file access requests
items.detail: Review Astrid Ortega’s batch of Litify project-access requests and David Molano’s request for the skill file, confirm each business need and permission level, then approve or decline them consistently.

items.label: Clarify the Denial and RFE categorization intake
items.detail: The request was routed to the Case Management Center of Excellence today. Confirm whether it needs project delivery, who owns the evaluation, and the next step after intake review.

items.label: Clear the overdue training and LeadUp follow-up
items.detail: Complete the Dominican Republic harassment-prevention course and the LeadUp Module 3 growth-mindset survey, or assign firm completion times for both.

items.label: Submit the team’s work-schedule patterns to HR
items.detail: Confirm each unique schedule in Eastern time and complete the survey by Friday, October 30.

items.label: Clarify timing for the PMO portfolio cleanup
items.detail: Confirm whether unlinking the three projects is required now or explicitly defer the cleanup so the team can plan it against higher-priority work.

items.label: Frank Von Hassell was assigned as BA for the Close Case Taskset
items.detail: The assignment notification names Frank as the Business Analyst and Jean as the project assignee.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Jhara 1:1 and Amazon Connect standup overlap
items.detail: Jhara remains out of office through November 2, although the 1:1 is still on the calendar. Confirm whether it will proceed and keep the Amazon Connect recovery check covered.

items.label: 11:00 AM to noon - Slides, CM CoE touchpoint, and protected work
items.detail: Prepare the shortest decision narrative during the slide block, carry only unresolved CM CoE issues into the 11:30 touchpoint, and preserve the noon hour for follow-through.

items.label: 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM - Leadership and portfolio sequence
items.detail: EPMO leadership is followed by Nicolas’s 1:1 at 3:30 PM and the CSC portfolio review at 4:00 PM. Reuse one clear risk, owner, and next-step narrative across the sequence.
